text:
mike_cs: Quick sync — Kaplan dedicated bring-up. We need final quota allocation + autoscale knobs by EOD so we can run the shadow load tomorrow. Who's on point for the quota sign-off?

sam_infra: I can own the smoke + shadow tests. Planning to run 10k qps ramp with our staging harness. Need the final quota numbers from CS to size pools.

julia_se: I'll do the customer enablement session Thurs 10am PT. Can we lock the model variants and rate limits before then? Need a short runbook to share.

ada_enable: I drafted the runbook here: https://docs.internal/redwood/kaplan-onboard-runbook (private). Highlights: warmup TTL 48h, KV cache priming, prefix-caching enabled. Will paste snippet below for quick review:
```
- quota: reserved 2000 tokens/sec
- burst cap: 5k tokens/sec (10s window)
- autoscale policy: cpu/latency based, min_instances=2, max_instances=12
- warmup: traffic replay 6h/day for 2 days
```

mike_cs: Nice. Kaplan legal asked about renewal exposure if SLA misses during ramp — we should flag that to AMs. Also need billing contact and KMS key confirmation.

sam_infra: Ops checklist for tomorrow:
- confirm quota applied (CS)
- run shadow 10k qps ramp (Infra)
- monitor 99th/latency and error-rate by model (Runtime)
- validate autoscale triggers (Infra)
- smoke canary route 5% traffic to dedicated pool (CS/SE)

ops-bot: Deploy scheduler: shadow-runner-v2 queued for 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z. CI artifacts: build-984. Reaction: :gear:.

mike_cs: mike_cs -> @sam_infra can you include a traffic profile file? last time we had uneven seq length and it spiked memory.

sam_infra: Yep. I'll attach `kaplan_profile_v3.json` to the run. It includes seq_len distribution and avg tokens. Also enabling KV eviction logging.

julia_se: For the enablement deck, please confirm safe defaults for token limits and error handling so SE can demo rollback. (Need bullets by EOD)

ada_enable: Sending bullets now:
- default max_tokens_per_request = 4096
- on 429: exponential backoff with jitter, fallback to smaller model variant
- circuit-breaker: 3 consecutive 5xx -> degrade to fallback variant and alert

mike_cs: Action items (short):
- CS: final quota sign-off (mike_cs) — due EOD
- Infra: shadow + smoke run (sam_infra) — scheduled tomorrow UTC
- SE: enablement deck + runbook note (julia_se, ada_enable) — due EOD
- Ops: confirm KMS & billing contact (mike_cs) — pinged legal

sam_infra: One more risk note — autoscale cooldown defaults may be too slow for bursty query patterns. I'll set cooldown=30s for the dedicated pool during the test and revert after.

mike_cs: Perfect. If we keep everything green after shadow, propose a canary shift Fri 04:00Z at 10% traffic for 1 hour. Will post final go/no-go 1hr before.

ada_enable: Copy. I'll prep the customer-facing checklist and share the deck link in this thread when ready.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: go/no-go reminder set 1769390000 (unix).

mike_cs: Thanks team — short check-ins tomorrow morning, otherwise post results here. :thumbsup:
